title: The 2026 Spanish Housing Protests and the Fight for Shelter

beats.text: A series of protests began in Spain following a high-profile eviction on September 23, 2026.
This eviction of 87-year-old María del Carmen Abascal brought the ongoing affordable housing crisis into the spotlight.
By September 26, protesters established a camp in Madrid's Puerta del Sol square.
Protesters call for the enforcement of the right to housing and increased protection against landlord abuse.
Prime Minister Pedro Sánchez agreed to an emergency relief package including a temporary ban on evictions.
People's Party and Vox blocked the parliamentary ratification of these measures on October 2.
Following the parliamentary defeat, Sánchez called a snap general election for November 29, 2026.
Government plans now seek to ratify enhanced housing decrees through the interim Permanent Deputation.
